beats.say: Swift 6 shipped complete data-race safety, but the first experience was a wall of errors in code that never meant to be concurrent.
Version six point two changes the defaults: app code starts on the main actor, async stays with its caller, and background work needs an explicit concurrent mark.
New app projects in Xcode twenty-six enable main-actor-by-default already, and the article is part one of eight on modern Swift.
